data_description: A deterministic hourly Muskingum routing problem with a confirmed route specification and gap-free (or explicitly broken) inflow table.
prompt: Use inflow.csv and route_spec.json exactly as supplied to run hydrological-modeling/route-muskingum-channel. The inflow table is hourly discharge in m3/s and contains at least one missing value in an inflow column. Run the routing verbatim with --timestep-hours 1 and only the native result.json under routed/. Do not fill, interpolate, or drop the missing value; do not rerun with repaired data; the script must reject the input itself. No routed_flow.csv or route_coefficients.json may remain in routed/.
setup_notes: The route specification is confirmed by the user and must not be altered.
All inflow values are instantaneous discharge in m3/s on a regular hourly axis.
Do not install software or implement a replacement routing routine.
title: Reject Muskingum routing when the inflow series contains missing values
